provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

design: These are stipulated locations in a periodic square simulation domain, not a bounded field plot with missing outside neighbors. The periodic distance uses min(abs(dx),L-abs(dx)) independently on each coordinate. Compare it with ordinary Euclidean distance on the same coordinates.
definition: For each supplied radius count ordered distinct-point pairs with distance<=radius. K(r)=area*ordered_count/[n*(n-1)]. Exclude self pairs; preserve every location once. This is the declared finite-panel estimator, not n squared normalization. No random-label or complete-spatial-randomness null experiment is provided.
scope: Use only this controlled spatial geometry; do not infer a significance level from whether estimated K exceeds pi*r^2.
